proved_reduction.statement: Any finite hill arrangement and any finite set of its counted bounded triangular faces can be projectively transformed to an affine arrangement with no parallel line pairs while preserving all selected counted bounded triangular faces.

remaining_gap.issue: The source-scoped global clean-line/fan extraction is not yet independently proved by GCL, and arrangements with four or more finite multiple points remain open. The unique q=3 residual is a saturated all-triple core triangle.
remaining_gap.target: Either rule out/replay the saturated q=3 template, extend the incidence budget to q>=4, or construct/replay 95.

claim_boundary: H1-12 is strictly narrowed, not closed. Parallelism is eliminated. Conditional on named source-scoped geometric premises, q=3 collapses to one saturated three-triple template; otherwise a 95 witness needs q>=4. No hill-global <=94, optimality, or MATHCERT claim.

source_conditional_reduction.statement: Conditional on the protected clean-line/fan premises, an n=18,T=95 normalized arrangement with exactly three finite multiple points must be the saturated three-triple core-triangle template: D1=6, D2=3, U=3, h=6, local d1=d2=2, and five triangular sectors at each core.
